entities.name: Herbert Böttcher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Herbert Kurt Böttcher was a German lawyer, and chief of police of Memel and Kassel. He was also an SS-Brigadeführer and Generalmajor of police who served as the last SS and Police Leader in Radom during the Second World War. After the war, he was tried and executed for Holocaust-related crimes.
